sources.title: HDMI LA — Variable Refresh Rate (VRR)
quotes: VRR enables a gaming source such as a console or computer to deliver video frames as fast as it can, which in many cases is slower than the normal static refresh rate.
VRR reduces or eliminates lag, judder and frame tearing for more fluid and better detailed gameplay.
By waiting until the next frame is ready to transport it, a smoother gaming experience can be provided to the user.

sources.title: HDMI LA — HDMI gaming features (VRR, ALLM, QFT)
quotes: Gaming-specific features include Variable Refresh Rate (VRR), Auto Low Latency Mode (ALLM) and Quick Frame Transport (QFT).
The Xbox Series X and Sony PS5 consoles were the first to support the latest HDMI-enabled gaming features

quotes: Variable Refresh Rate (VRR) reduces or eliminates lag, stutter and frame tearing for more fluid and better detailed gameplay.
